notes: Multi-line passages, as the stream tips advise for code poles. Probes: repeated print banner 1.02, repeated log.write banner 0.67, commented print run 0.50; parallel assignments 0.006, begin/endReset calls 0.22, try block 0.02. The + pole fires on 'try' / ':' that opens a block, so the unit may separate 'same pattern continues' from 'a new block opens'. Near misses here drop the repetition together with the print calls, so a hold would not separate the two.
